environment.description: Same NestJS microservice on ECS Fargate (4 replicas) behind ALB. PostgreSQL 15 on RDS with PgBouncer 1.21 configured with pool_mode=statement and server_prepared_statements=yes (pgbouncer.ini). The RDS parameter group has default_transaction_isolation set to 'serializable' via custom DB cluster parameter group (aurora-postgresql15-serializable). PgBouncer's query routing with statement-level pooling combined with the serializable isolation means concurrent TOCTOU reads on the same row will trigger serialization failures (ERROR 40001) which abort the second transaction. Additionally, the RDS instance has pg_advisory_xact_lock calls enforced via a BEFORE UPDATE trigger on the accounts table that acquires an exclusive advisory lock on the account row's id hash.

config.database: PostgreSQL 15 on RDS, custom parameter group aurora-postgresql15-serializable
config.trigger: BEFORE UPDATE trigger on accounts: PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(NEW.id::text))
